description.value: Sahhali on the Bluffs is a vacation rental property perched on a bluff on Pender Island, offering a cottage and several suites with 180-degree views of the Salish Sea toward Vancouver Island and the San Juan Islands. The property is accessible by BC Ferries and sits on one of the island's highest vantage points, in a peaceful setting where guests commonly spot orcas, humpback whales, and bald eagles. Pender Island is a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination, and the cottage listing specifically mentions hiking and cycling as local activities.

address.value: Pirates Rd, Pender Island, BC V0N 2M2, Canada

The property is described as a 'gated sanctuary' vacation rental without on-site staff, which makes staff-based bike procedures unlikely without verification.
